summary: The implementation matches the spec. rock.json gains postflopValue {75, justification} and the A-2 description clause. style.ts validates the block (object; finite thresholdPct in [50,100]; justification >= 10 words), uses the exact spec messages and reports all problems together. decideRock keeps an advised bet or raise only when Math.round(eq*10) > Math.round(threshold*10) (rounded tenths, strictly greater); otherwise it checks when nothing is owed and calls when a bet is owed. It uses no RNG, so the Rock stays deterministic. The style-bands test computes VPIP/PFR (preflop call/raise; blinds excluded because they are not call/raise records) and aggression (postflop bet+raise over bet+raise+call) per bot seat by hand.lineUp style, over dealt-in seats with seat 1 excluded, as A-1/A-4 require. It is gated by TLH_SLOW_TESTS and listed in test:slow, so it adds no every-push cost; the every-push rock-postflop file runs in ~20 ms. I ran seed 42 at 100k hands and it passed: TAG 22.2/16.2/63.0, Rock 10.1/8.8/47.0, in 151 s. The builder's rock.test edit is sound. One MAJOR: the unchanged, pre-existing 1,000-hand 'seated Rocks' unit test risks the TASK-1.52 10 s CI limit; dropping it to 300 hands keeps every assertion.
